Hi @ida, found the design review decision in my notes. The agreed formula is (new - old) * 100 / abs(old). This uses the absolute value of the baseline so direction is preserved even with negative numbers. For -50 to -25: (-25 - (-50)) * 100 / 50 = 50.0. Hope that unblocks you!
